raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

DFLASH falls back to FlashInfer when the target attention backend is unsupported by the draft, including DSA targets. FA4 is faster for this draft path on B200.

## Modifications

Use FA4 as the fallback on SM100 and SM110. Other CUDA GPUs keep FlashInfer; ROCm and XPU keep Triton. An explicitly selected draft backend still takes precedence.

## Accuracy Tests

CPU backend-selection regressions and scoped formatting pass on the updated branch. The fallback regression failed before the fix.

The draft attention kernel changes. Earlier B200 backport runs had similar accepted tokens per verify step with either backend, but do not establish numerical equivalence. This branch has not been run end to end on SM100; SM110 execution remains unverified.

Run the unit suites with `python -m pytest` and scoped formatting with `pre-commit run --files <changed-files>`.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

These measurements came from a v0.5.20 backport with GLM-5.3-Flash FP8, TP8 B200, an 8-layer DFLASH drafter, cached 60K-token prompts and EAGLE decoding. Time per verify step:

| Draft attention backend | 1 request | 4 requests | 16 requests |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| FlashInfer | 9.05 ms | 11.32 ms | 16.03 ms |
| FA4 | 7.14 ms | 9.45 ms | 14.20 ms |

The speed results have not been repeated on this branch.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@Qiaolin-Yu, could you review the DFLASH fallback change? It selects FA4 on SM100/SM110 when the target backend cannot serve draft attention.

B200 measurement of this branch on main.

Setup: one B200 node, 4 GPUs (TP4), SGLang main nightly `lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-20261013-7224fce1` (commit 7224fce1b5e4, FlashInfer 0.7.1). The PR arm overlays `speculative_hook.py` from 43bfd22c71. The image copy of this file equals the merge base. Model: GLM-5.3-Flash architecture, an FP8 fine-tuned checkpoint. Drafter: `incoai/GLM-5.3-Flash-DFlash2` (5 layers, block size 8, 2,048-token sliding window). Flags: `--tp-size 4 --speculative-algorithm DFLASH --linear-attn-verify-backend nv_cutedsl --dsa-prefill-backend trtllm --dsa-decode-backend trtllm --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_trtllm`, with breakable prefill CUDA graphs and the `prefill_shapes` warmup. The server logs show the draft fallback to `flashinfer` on main and to `fa4` with this branch. Workload: 16 cached prompts of about 60K tokens, 1,536 output tokens per stream at temperature 1.0 and top-p 0.95.

Time per verify step (2 servers per arm, 2 measured passes per server):

| Streams | main (FlashInfer draft) | this PR (FA4 draft) | Saved |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 10.160 ms | 8.281 ms | 1.88 ms (1.23x) |
| 4 | 13.927 ms | 12.072 ms | 1.85 ms (1.15x) |
| 16 | 20.515 ms | 18.727 ms | 1.79 ms (1.10x) |

The two servers of each arm agreed within 0.5%. Another job used the other 4 GPUs of the node. Accepted tokens per step were the same within noise (main 3.11 to 3.48, this PR 3.09 to 3.40). Quality was not worse than main in a greedy decode check with a prefill re-score as the reference (mean |decode - prefill| log prob 0.0225 and 0.0208 against 0.0262 and 0.0241 on main). Not validated: TP8, SM110 and other GPUs.

@@ -859,11 +859,13 @@ def get_fallback_backend() -> str:
                 )
             return fallback_backend
         # FlashInfer is CUDA-only; fall back to triton on XPU and ROCm.
-        return (
-            "triton"
-            if (get_platform().is_xpu or get_platform().is_hip)
-            else "flashinfer"
-        )
+        if get_platform().is_xpu or get_platform().is_hip:
+            return "triton"
+        # On SM100/SM110, FA4 runs the draft attention much faster than FlashInfer
+        # (GLM-5.3-Flash on B200: 7.1 ms instead of 9.1 ms per DFLASH step).
+        if get_platform().is_sm100_or_sm110:
+            return "fa4"
+        return "flashinfer"
 
     draft_backend = cfg.speculative_draft_attention_backend
     if draft_backend is None:

@@ -0,0 +1,53 @@
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
+
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.overrides import resolution_result
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.speculative_hook import (
+    _resolve_dflash_draft_attention_backend,
+)
+from sglang.srt.platforms.interface import SRTPlatform
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+HOOK_MODULE = "sglang.srt.arg_groups.speculative_hook"
+
+
+class TestDFlashDraftBackendFallback(CustomTestCase):
+    def _resolve(self, *, sm100: bool = False, hip: bool = False, xpu: bool = False):
+        args = ServerArgs(
+            model_path="dummy",
+            device="custom",
+            speculative_algorithm="DFLASH",
+            speculative_draft_model_path="draft",
+            speculative_num_draft_tokens=4,
+        )
+        platform = Mock(spec=SRTPlatform)
+        platform.is_out_of_tree.return_value = False
+        device = SimpleNamespace(is_xpu=xpu, is_hip=hip, is_sm100_or_sm110=sm100)
+        with (
+            patch(f"{HOOK_MODULE}.current_platform", platform),
+            patch(f"{HOOK_MODULE}.get_platform", return_value=device),
+            # A target backend the DFLASH draft worker does not support.
+            patch(f"{HOOK_MODULE}.attention_backends_of", return_value=("dsa", None)),
+            self.assertLogs(HOOK_MODULE, "WARNING"),
+        ):
+            _resolve_dflash_draft_attention_backend(args)
+        return resolution_result(args, "speculative_draft_attention_backend")
+
+    def test_unsupported_target_backend_falls_back_to_fa4_on_sm100(self):
+        self.assertEqual(self._resolve(sm100=True), "fa4")
+
+    def test_other_cuda_gpus_keep_flashinfer(self):
+        self.assertEqual(self._resolve(), "flashinfer")
+
+    def test_rocm_and_xpu_keep_triton(self):
+        self.assertEqual(self._resolve(hip=True), "triton")
+        self.assertEqual(self._resolve(xpu=True), "triton")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
